name: MonarchButton
title: Button
summary: A button in eight variants and three sizes with the web's look, a loading state and optional icons.
whenToUse: For an action. Use one primary button per screen region; the default variant is secondary.
whenNotToUse: For navigation inside text use a link. For an icon without a label use MonarchIconButton.
api: @Composable fun MonarchButton(text: String, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: MonarchButtonVariant = MonarchButtonVariant.Secondary, size: MonarchButtonSize = MonarchButtonSize.Md, enabled: Boolean = true, loading: Boolean = false, leadingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, trailingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, loadingLabel: String? = null, shape: Shape? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchButton(onClick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: MonarchButtonVariant = MonarchButtonVariant.Secondary, size: MonarchButtonSize = MonarchButtonSize.Md, enabled: Boolean = true, loading: Boolean = false, loadingLabel: String? = null, shape: Shape? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null, content: @Composable RowScope.() -> Unit)
enum class MonarchButtonVariant { Primary, Secondary, Ghost, Danger, DangerSubtle, Success, Warning, Link }
enum class MonarchButtonSize { Sm, Md, Lg }

options.name: onClick
options.description: Runs when activated, unless loading or disabled.

options.name: variant
options.description: Primary, Secondary, Ghost, Danger, DangerSubtle, Success, Warning or Link.

options.name: size
options.description: Sm 32dp, Md 36dp or Lg 40dp high; the touch target is 48dp.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the user can activate the button.

options.name: loading
options.description: Shows a spinner in place of the leading icon (or over the label) and ignores taps; the button keeps its size.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: To observe or drive press and focus.

options.name: content
options.description: Second overload: custom content instead of text and icons.

options.name: shape
options.description: The outline of the button and its focus ring; null uses the medium Monarch shape. A button group passes the shape of each position.

states.name: resting
states.description: The fill, border and label color of the variant; primary, secondary, danger, success and warning have the xs shadow.

states.name: hovered
states.description: The hover fill of the variant (accent, danger, success or warning solid hover; muted for neutral buttons).

states.name: pressed
states.description: The pressed fill of the variant and the ripple in the label color.

states.name: focused
states.description: The Monarch focus ring, 2dp, with a 2dp gap, around the visible button.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The variant at half opacity, like the web; announced as disabled.

states.name: loading
states.description: A spinner takes the place of the leading icon, or is drawn over the label when there is no icon; the button keeps its size; taps are ignored; the state is announced.

appearance: Primary is filled with the accent, danger with the danger color, success and warning with their solid roles, in every theme. Secondary is a bordered surface, ghost has no fill, danger-subtle is the tinted danger fill with a danger border, link is the link color with an underline. In the high-contrast themes the same roles resolve to stronger colors.
platformNotes: Built from its own layers, not the Material 3 Button, because that button forces a 40dp minimum height. The visible heights are the web's 32, 36 and 40dp (decision D10); the 48dp touch target is reserved around the button in the layout, and a tap in the reserved space presses the button. The web xs size and the brand variant are not offered on touch platforms. Disabled is the variant at half opacity, like the web. A loading button keeps its size: the spinner replaces the leading icon, or is drawn over the label when there is none.
accessibility: Has the button role and the label as its name.
The touch target is at least 48dp by 48dp at every size and reserves that space in the layout.
While loading it keeps its place in the focus order, ignores taps and announces Loading, or loadingLabel, as its state.
A disabled button is announced as disabled.
The label wraps and the button grows instead of being cut off at large font sizes.
Draws the focus ring around the visible button for keyboard and switch navigation.
Icons are at the start and end and follow the layout direction.
edgeCases: A long label wraps and the button grows in height.
loading does not change the size of the button.
A small button is 32dp high but takes 48dp of layout height.
